nodes.description: Public constant state variable adapterType = "Asset"; overrides ProtocolAdapter.adapterType().
Public constant state variable tokenType = "ERC20"; overrides ProtocolAdapter.tokenType().
Internal constant address TOKEN_CONTROLLER (0x5407381b...) used as the target of the totalBalanceOf external call.
Internal constant address NXM (0xd7c49CEE...) used as the ERC20 token whose balanceOf is queried.
External view function getBalance(address, address account) returns uint256; computes totalBalance - tokenBalance for the given account.
Unchecked subtraction totalBalance - tokenBalance; reverts/underflows when tokenBalance exceeds totalBalance.
Named parameter account of getBalance; passed to TokenController.totalBalanceOf and ERC20(NXM).balanceOf.
Unnamed address parameter in the getBalance signature; declared but never used in the body.
Local variable tokenBalance, result of ERC20(NXM).balanceOf(account).

edges.reason: State variable TOKEN_CONTROLLER is read inside getBalance to build the TokenController contract target.
State variable NXM is read inside getBalance to build the ERC20 token target.
Parameter account flows into getBalance body and is forwarded to both external balance queries.
Unnamed address parameter is declared in the getBalance signature.
TOKEN_CONTROLLER address is used in the external call whose return value is stored in totalBalance.
NXM address is used in the ERC20 call whose return value is stored in tokenBalance.
getBalance executes the subtraction expression that returns the function result.
totalBalance is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction, enabling integer underflow.
tokenBalance is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction, enabling integer underflow.
getBalance performs the external ERC20 balanceOf call that assigns tokenBalance.

normalization_plan.reason: account is only meaningful as the input passed to the external balance lookups inside getBalance.
The unnamed address parameter belongs solely to the getBalance signature and carries no independent state.
totalBalance exists only to feed the subtraction that produces the returned balance.
tokenBalance exists only to feed the subtraction that produces the returned balance.
